mapper.sql: select s.style_id, s.style_code, s.style_name, s.season, s.style_type, s.gender, s.fabric_name, s.fabric_composition, s.code_mode, s.special_body_support, s.care_instructions, s.status, ifnull(sz.size_count, 0) as size_count, sz.size_summary, ifnull(bm.bom_count, 0) as bom_count, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from xf_uniform_style s left join ( select style_id, count(1) as size_count, group_concat( concat( coalesce(nullif(size_name, ''), size_code), case special_type when '1' then '(加肥)' when '2' then '(加长)' when '3' then '(加肥加长)' else '' end ) order by sort_order asc, size_id asc separator '、' ) as size_summary from xf_uniform_style_size group by style_id ) sz on s.style_id = sz.style_id left join ( select style_id, count(1) as bom_count from xf_uniform_style_bom group by style_id ) bm on s.style_id = bm.style_id
mapper.insert: insert into xf_uniform_style( style_code, style_name, season, style_type, gender, fabric_name, fabric_composition, code_mode, special_body_support, care_instructions, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{styleCode}, #{styleName}, #{season}, #{styleType}, #{gender}, #{fabricName}, #{fabricComposition}, #{codeMode}, #{specialBodySupport}, #{careInstructions}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
